abilities.name: Pocztowy Demonspear
_curatorNotes: Out-of-stance polearm normals: 5-hit Physical chain. attackHitmarks=[[11],[11],[16],[20,29],[29]]; N4 is multi-hit, last hitmark=29 gates cancel. attackFrames built via InitNormalCancelSlice. Per-hit ActionAttack/ActionCharge overrides give next-N / charge-cancel windows. N5 final hit per convention has no C key.
N4 ActionCharge not explicitly set in attack.go (defaults to animLen=67 — non-meaningful cancel); C key omitted from N4 hits[].

Charge: chargeFrames=InitAbilSlice(60), ActionSkill/Burst/Dash/Jump=28 (chargeHitmark), ActionWalk=52, ActionSwap=43. Standard polearm CA shape. NextQueueItemIsValid forbids C from idle (NormalCounter==0); polearm convention.
Plunge frames not authored — flins has no plunge.go in gcsim source (uses default polearm plunge frames not curated here).

Charged-attack element-application ICD: gcsim charge.go tags it ICDTagExtraAttack / ICDGroupPoleExtraAttack, whose reset timer is 30f (0.5s) with only the first hit of each window applying (pkg/core/attacks/icd_groups.dm.go). Authored as chargedIcdWindow rather than a weapon-type rule in resolveActionIcd: the census is 16 of 19 oracled polearm users, and Xiao, Raiden and Emilie sit on the default. Reachable only while the swing is infused - bare, a polearm charged attack is Physical and applies nothing.

abilities.name: Pocztowy Demonspear (Manifest Flame)
_curatorNotes: In-stance normals: same frame data as base (gcsim shares attackFrames between Attack() and skillAttack()), only Element=Electro and ICD/scaling differ. AttackTagNormal preserved (still normal-typed). IgnoreInfusion:true blocks override.
Damage: skillAttack[i] multipliers per skillAttack_1..5 in flins_gen.go. N1=110.6%, N2=111.7%, N3=131.1%, N4=2×83.4%, N5=180.0% Electro at TalentLvl 10.
Authored as a normal-typed dual variant with state condition (varesa/cyno-shape). Plunging is disabled — flagged in caveat.

Charged-attack element-application ICD: gcsim charge.go tags it ICDTagExtraAttack / ICDGroupPoleExtraAttack, whose reset timer is 30f (0.5s) with only the first hit of each window applying (pkg/core/attacks/icd_groups.dm.go). Authored as chargedIcdWindow rather than a weapon-type rule in resolveActionIcd: the census is 16 of 19 oracled polearm users, and Xiao, Raiden and Emilie sit on the default. Reachable only while the swing is infused - bare, a polearm charged attack is Physical and applies nothing.

↻ CLOSED BY MEASUREMENT 2026-09-16 (T0.5 tranche). The 2026-08-19 pass removed the plunge caveat and instructed a retarget onto the drawn block; there IS no drawn block. Measured `Flins E N1 P N2`: the P emits no action event, no input block and no application - run.ts refuses an unresolvable plunge (no plungeFrames on either normal, and gcsim has no plunge.go for him), and castTokensIn() only sees E/Q tokens so the editor does not flag it either. A typed P is silent everywhere, which is the corpus-wide §1.D class (84 of 126 characters), not a Flins divergence - it wants the plunge-policy round (refuse the token, or draw a provisional strip), not a per-character caveat. The in-game refusal inside Manifest Flame is then a second-order fact about a token that already draws nothing.

abilities.name: Ancient Rite: Arcane Light
_curatorNotes: Tap E (out-of-stance): activates Manifest Flame state for 10s + skillHitmark=19f. Issues a 0-damage Electro tag attack at hitmark=19f (gcsim 'Arcane Light (0 dmg)' — exists for PJWS proc accumulation, not for damage). No element particle generation on this base cast.

behavior:stance with terminatesOnSwap:true matches the in-game behavior — leaving the field cancels Manifest Flame (onExitField in skill.go drops skillKey/spearStormCDKey/thunderousSymphonyKey on swap-out).
Cooldown: SetCDWithDelay(skill, 16*60, skillHitmark=19) — 16s starting from cast frame 19. Authored as cooldown:16 + cooldownStartDelay:19.

Skill frames: skillFrames=InitAbilSlice(44), ActionAttack=19 ActionSkill=22 (E→E recast cancel into Spearstorm) ActionBurst=19 ActionDash=17 ActionJump=18 ActionSwap=17. Per E-spec swap/N/E/Q/D/J — E key included since Spearstorm IS a meaningful E→E sequence.

Manifest Flame opens inStance (default for behavior:stance). When inStance is active: (a) normals route to the in-stance Pocztowy Demonspear variant (Electro infusion); (b) E recast routes to Northland Spearstorm; (c) plunge is disabled in-game (not modelled). Manifest Flame is modelled as the generic 'inStance' state (no flins-specific State enum value).

application: [] is the positive claim that this cast applies nothing (2026-09-16). gcsim skill.go:66-78 queues 'Arcane Light (0 dmg)' with AttackTagNone and NO Durability field - it exists to stack PJWS, not to touch the gauge. The previous entry (frame 19, no units) became a provisional 1U Electro, and Flins is a Lunar-Charged ENABLER, so it manufactured a phantom reaction and a phantom Thundercloud at 0.32s. It still LANDS a hit (a real QueueAttack), so nonHitting is deliberately not set.
abilities.description:
Flins summons forth the ancient power concealed within his lamp and switches to his Manifest Flame form. This form has the following characteristics:
· Flins's Normal and Charged Attacks deal Electro DMG that cannot be overridden by other Elemental infusions, and he is unable to perform Plunging Attacks.
· His interruption resistance is increased.
· His Elemental Skill Ancient Rite: Arcane Light is replaced with the special Elemental Skill Northland Spearstorm.

Northland Spearstorm
Flins summons a flurry of spears in front, dealing AoE Electro DMG and causing his Elemental Burst Ancient Ritual: Cometh the Night to be replaced with the special Elemental Burst **Thunderous Symphony** for the next 6s.
The base CD of Northland Spearstorm is 6s and will not be affected by other effects.

Separate cooldown from base skill — gcsim uses spearStormCDKey (status), not the main ActionSkill CD. Base 6s, C1 reduces to 4s. Authored via cooldownModifiers entry. The base Arcane Light CD continues running independently.
Frames: spearStormFrames=InitAbilSlice(42), ActionAttack=28 ActionBurst=28 ActionDash=26 ActionJump=26 ActionWalk=32. No explicit ActionSwap → swap=42 (animLen).

sQ WIRED (post-P4 transient-state primitive, 2026-07-17): opensTransientState opens `symphonyWindow` for 6s at cast (gcsim skill.go AddStatus(thunderousSymphonyKey, 6*60)); during it the KQM `sQ` token resolves the Thunderous Symphony burst variant on Cometh the Night (see its variant + notes). terminatesOnSwap: gcsim's 'flins-exit' hook deletes the status when Flins leaves the field. Re-cast refreshes the window.

C2 Devil's Wall: +50% ATK Electro Lunar-Charged DMG on next NA within 6s after Spearstorm — the action-event substrate landed (post-P4 #2, 2026-07-17) but the effect stays unmodeled: onHit dispatch from actions is unwired (substrate-only) and Lunar-Charged DMG is Tier-2-frozen. Full status in the C2 _curatorNotes.

[A7] Thunderous Symphony hit figures (single Lunar-Charged Electro hit, 171.7% ATK at talent 10; +258.7% ATK extra hit under Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam) are damage math — out of scope for user caveats; already recorded in the burst _curatorNotes.

variants.label: Thunderous Symphony
_curatorNotes: application: [] (2026-09-16) - a variant with no application[] inherits the BASE burst's, which put Electro at cast+93 and cast+164 for an ability whose only hit lands at 44f. Thunderous Symphony is a single AttackTagDirectLunarCharged hit with no Durability (gcsim burst.go:102-117), so it applies nothing; the Moonsign extra hit at +62 is the same shape.

4-phase burst: initial hit at burstHitmarkInitial=93f (619.7% ATK Electro elemental burst), then 2 mid-phase Lunar-Charged hits at +17/+26 (16.2% ATK each at lvl=10), and 1 final-phase hit at +62 (155.0% ATK Lunar-Charged). With Moonsign Ascendant Gleam: +2 additional mid hits at +35/+44.
Mid + final hits are AttackTagDirectLunarCharged with IgnoreDefPercent=1 (lunar-charged DMG ignores 100% def).
Burst frames: burstFrames=InitAbilSlice(130), ActionAttack=102 ActionSkill=103 ActionDash=103 ActionJump=103 ActionWalk=130 ActionSwap=91. Per Q-spec swap/N/E/D/J.
Cooldown: SetCD(burst, 15*60). Genshin-db stub had 20 — using gcsim's authoritative 15.
ConsumeEnergy(4) on cast — drains 4 energy from teammates; not modelled.

Thunderous Symphony variant WIRED via the KQM `sQ` token (2026-07-17): gated on the `symphonyWindow` transient state Spearstorm opens; consumesState closes the window on cast (gcsim DeleteStatus). bypassesCooldown per gcsim flins.go ActionReady — while the window is active the burst CD check is SKIPPED entirely (only the 30-energy gate applies, which the planner doesn't simulate), and thunderousSymphony() sets no CD, so cooldown: 0 and the shared clock is untouched. Frames: symphonyFrames=InitAbilSlice(81), ActionAttack=53 ActionSkill=53 ActionDash=51 ActionJump=50, no explicit ActionSwap → swap=81 (animLen). Single Lunar-Charged hit at symphonyHitmark=44f (171.7% ATK), +1 extra hit at +18 (258.7% ATK) if Moonsign Ascendant Gleam. ConsumeEnergyPartial(3, 30).

application[] trimmed to the initial hit (2026-09-16). gcsim burst.go:49-88: only 'Cometh the Night (Initial)' carries Durability: 25. The two mid hits (+17/+26 from the f93 task) and the final (+71) are AttackTagDirectLunarCharged with NO Durability, so they deal damage and touch no gauge. The 110/119/164 entries were therefore phantom, and the f164 one survived the per-cast standard ICD sequence {1,0,0} by wrapping on the fourth entry. gcsim-frames-diff.md lists those frames under [icd] - the oracle cannot tell a suppressed hit from a zero-durability one.

constellations.name: Part the Veil of Snow
_curatorNotes: Two effects: (1) Spearstorm CD reduced to 4s — authored on Spearstorm via cooldownModifiers entry (constellation:1). (2) +8 Energy to Flins per team Lunar-Charged proc, 5.5s ICD — authored as energy effect with onReaction:lunarCharged trigger and procCooldown:5.5. Triggers regardless of which character procs Lunar-Charged.

The basic cooldown of the special Elemental Skill Northland Spearstorm is reduced to 4s.
Additionally, when party members trigger Lunar-Charged reactions, Flins will recover 8 Elemental Energy. This effect can occur once every 5.5s.

constellations.name: The Devil's Wall
_curatorNotes: Effect 2 (Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam) AUTHORED with the onHit wiring (2026-07-17): -25% Electro RES for 7s, refreshing, on any of Flins's own Electro hits. abilityType lists all five classes EXPLICITLY (constellation-hosted onHit effects need explicit declaration for the N/CA/P collection rule); the element filter does the real gating — E/Q casts are Electro, Manifest Flame stance NAs/CAs are Electro-infused, out-of-stance physical attacks fail the filter. Gated on C2 + teamFaction moonsign>=2 (the Ascendant Gleam requirement). Renders in the resShred debuff row (post-P4 #5 buff windows): E/Q casts anchor per-cast; in-stance NA swings anchor PER-SWING with refresh-merge, so an NA string shows one continuous shred window trailing the last swing by 7s.

Effect 1 (Devil's Wall — next NA hit after Spearstorm deals +50% ATK as AoE Electro Lunar-Charged DMG, 6s window) remains UNMODELED: the substrate exists (per-swing NA hits + the symphonyWindow transient state), but the damage is Lunar-Charged reaction DMG — Tier-2 schema work frozen by Nate. Do not author until the freeze lifts.
constellations.description:
For the next 6s after using the special Elemental Skill Northland Spearstorm, when Flins's next Normal Attack hits an opponent, it will deal an additional 50% of Flins's ATK as AoE Electro DMG. This DMG is considered Lunar-Charged DMG.
Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: While Flins is on the field, after his Electro attacks hit an opponent, that opponent's Electro RES will be decreased by 25% for 7s.

constellations.name: Songs and Dances of Death
_curatorNotes: Two effects: (1) +35% Lunar-Charged Elevation (Flins's casts only) — gcsim c6Init applies +0.35 Elevation to AttackTagDirectLunarCharged and AttackTagReactionLunarCharge. (2) Moonsign Ascendant Gleam: +10% Lunar-Charged Elevation team-wide; Flins gets the team +10 on top of her self +35 (target=team includes self) — matches gcsim's flins=0.45 / other=0.10 split. Authored 2026-05-10 with the new `elevate` effect type — multiplicative tier distinct from reaction-bonus stat keys. Renderer maps single-reaction elevations to the matching `lunar*DmgBonus` for display.

`trigger: passive` chosen since the elevation is permanent while Cons:6 (and Moonsign:2 for the team effect). Currently renders as a bonus chip in TeamBonusesBlock, not as a timeline bar — same behaviour as other passive-trigger buffs.
